name: Transport & Automotive
seo: Cars and scooters on Cebu: dealerships and second-hand lots, motorcycle sales, mechanics and vulcanising shops, car wash and detailing, window tinting, plus registration and insurance. Repair shops are listed by district with what they specialise in — useful when something fails on the way to Moalboal.

subSeo.Car Sales: Dealerships and second-hand lots — Toyota, Honda, BYD, Changan and used-car yards.
subSeo.Scooter Sales: Motorcycle and scooter dealers, parts and accessories.
subSeo.Driving Schools: LTO-accredited driving schools and licence assistance. Being added.
subSeo.Auto Repairs: Mechanics, vulcanising shops, car aircon, detailing, tinting and parts suppliers by district.
subSeo.Registration & Insurance: LTO registration, transfer of ownership and motor insurance. Being added.
